description: Nora is organizing a birthday gathering for her father and must finalize the format, song, timing, and sound setup for a small family performance.

shared_context.S1: The family is gathering at Nora's house for her father's birthday on Saturday, October 17, 2026.
shared_context.S2: Nora's draft plan is a surprise performance at 20:00 using a borrowed portable speaker.
shared_context.S3: The performance is intended to be a short family moment in the living room before dessert.
shared_context.S4: Nora's usual planning routine is to go around the group before finalizing a family event and ask each person for wishes, scheduling issues, or practical constraints.

PF1.text: Mia's father told her directly that he would rather have the performance announced than be surprised, and that he wants the family to perform "Moon River"; he has not told the rest of the group.

PF2.text: Caleb's work schedule means he can play only from 18:30 through 18:45 on October 17, 2026; he has not yet mentioned this scheduling restriction to Nora.

PF3.text: Rina learned from the next-door neighbor that the neighbor's newborn will be sleeping during the gathering and asked the family to use no amplification at all; Rina has not passed that request on yet.

acceptance_conditions: The performance must be announced rather than presented as a surprise.
The family must perform Moon River.
The performance must use no amplification.
Caleb must be committed to playing during the performance.
The neighbor's no-amplification request must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: 'Announced' in decisions['performance_format'] or 'announced' in decisions['performance_format'] or 'not surprise' in decisions['performance_format'] or 'not a surprise' in decisions['performance_format']
content_checks.C4: 'no amplification' in decisions['amplification'] or 'No amplification' in decisions['amplification'] or 'acoustic' in decisions['amplification'] or 'Acoustic' in decisions['amplification'] or 'unplugged' in decisions['amplification'] or 'Unplugged' in decisions['amplification'] or 'no portable speaker' in decisions['amplification'] or 'No portable speaker' in decisions['amplification'] or decisions['amplification'] == 'none' or decisions['amplification'] == 'None'
content_checks.C5: decisions['performance_start_time'] in ('18:30', '6:30 PM') and any(('18:30' in c['detail'] or '6:30 PM' in c['detail']) and ('performance' in c['detail'] or 'Performance' in c['detail'] or 'window' in c['detail'] or 'Window' in c['detail'] or 'start' in c['detail'] or 'Start' in c['detail'] or 'ready' in c['detail'] or 'Ready' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: 'no amplification' in decisions['amplification'] or 'No amplification' in decisions['amplification'] or 'acoustic' in decisions['amplification'] or 'Acoustic' in decisions['amplification'] or 'unplugged' in decisions['amplification'] or 'Unplugged' in decisions['amplification'] or 'no portable speaker' in decisions['amplification'] or 'No portable speaker' in decisions['amplification'] or decisions['amplification'] == 'none' or decisions['amplification'] == 'None' or any('neighbor' in c['detail'] or 'Neighbor' in c['detail'] or 'newborn' in c['detail'] or 'Newborn' in c['detail'] or 'no amplification' in c['detail'] or 'No amplification' in c['detail'] or 'unplugged' in c['detail'] or 'Unplugged' in c['detail'] or 'no portable speaker' in c['detail'] or 'No portable speaker' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The honoree's stated preference changes the format from Nora's planned surprise to an announced performance and changes the song choice to Moon River.
Caleb's exact availability changes the start time from the planned 20:00 to 18:30 and makes a Caleb performance commitment necessary.
The neighbor's request changes the sound setup from Nora's planned portable speaker to no amplification and requires the quiet acoustic plan to be acknowledged.
